turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
Mostly fatigue and non-restful sleep, and I also have a sore throat, cough, and diarrhea/increased stool frequency.
How long have you been experiencing these symptoms?

I don’t know. My symptoms include fatigue with non-restful sleep, a sore throat, cough, and diarrhea/increased stool frequency. Also, I’ve had contact with someone with similar symptoms in the past 2 weeks, and in the last month I’ve been in contact with someone infected with the Ebola virus, and I traveled out of the country to West Africa in the last 4 weeks.
Have you had a measured fever (≥100.4°F / 38°C) or experienced significant chills/sweats since these symptoms began?
Have you noticed any unusual bleeding (such as from your gums or nose), easy bruising, or a new skin rash?
Yes. I have noticed unusual bleeding or bruising related to my consultation today.
